snippet.title: Vaska — Announcement Trailer | A Cat Lost in a Dark Forest
snippet.description:
Meet Vaska — a cat lost in a strange and dangerous forest...
Move quietly, hide, solve puzzles, and find your way home!

🎮 Vaska is an atmospheric puzzle-platformer inspired by Slavic folklore.
Explore a dark, shifting forest, avoid twisted fairytale creatures, and uncover its secrets.

Wishlist on Steam!

Developed by IGR Studio.

📧 igor@igrstudio.art
